behavior.summaryEndpoint: GET /workspaces/:organizationId/notifications/summary aggregates totalUnread count and category breakdown (byCategory) with strict tenant isolation and role-based scoping (elevated roles see all workspace unread, members see unassigned and own assigned unread)
behavior.paymentFailedNotifications: createPaymentFailedNotification generates idempotent PAYMENT_FAILED notifications with category BILLING, eventKey billing:payment_failed:<invoiceId>, linking to /workspaces/:orgId/billing
behavior.subscriptionEventNotifications: createSubscriptionEventNotification generates idempotent SUBSCRIPTION_UPDATED and SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELED notifications with category BILLING, eventKey billing:subscription:<subscriptionId>:<eventType>, linking to /workspaces/:orgId/billing
behavior.contentReadyNotifications: createContentReadyNotification generates idempotent CONTENT_READY notifications with category CONTENT, eventKey content:<contentId>:ready, linking to /workspaces/:orgId/content/:contentId
